papers.what_it_is: A method paper that trains an SVM as a QUBO on a coherent Ising machine, weights the sampled solutions with a Boltzmann distribution, and adds batch processing, a multi-batch ensemble and one-vs-one voting, tested on two banknote datasets and IRIS in simulation and on a 550-qubit CIM.
